[{"insert":"Aerobic Push Pull

This is a steady aerobic piece that mixes pushing, pulling, and cardio for twelve minutes straight. The goal is a smooth pace you can hold, not a max effort, so don't chase failure on the push ups or the snatches. Take short breaks when you need them so your rest stays minimal and you keep moving. Think steady engine, not sprint.
"}]
